edges.reason: msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address, so caller controls token movement.
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender, so caller identity gates ownership restoration.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is decremented.
lock sets _lockTime from block.timestamp + time, making unlock timing timestamp dependent.
unlock compares block.timestamp against _lockTime.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the Uniswap liquidity deadline.
airdrop calls removeAllFee/restoreAllFee which overwrite and restore _taxFee.
airdrop removes and restores _liquidityFee around the transfer.
_getValues performs the mul/sub reflection arithmetic that determines all transfer amounts.
_rTotal feeds the rate computation used by the reflection arithmetic.
Computed reflection amounts are written into _rOwned for sender and recipient.
Computed token amounts are written into _tOwned for excluded accounts.
claimTokens executes the ETH transfer to the marketing wallet.
The drained ETH balance is sent to the owner-controlled marketingWallet.
swapAndLiquify pays the marketing share via the ETH transfer operation.
marketingWallet receives the ETH share computed inside swapAndLiquify.
claimOtherTokens invokes an external ERC20 transfer on an owner-supplied token address.
clearStuckBalance performs the ETH transfer to the supplied payable address.
swapTokensForEth performs the router swap call.
The swap call targets the uniswapV2Router state variable.
addLiquidity performs the router addLiquidityETH call.
The addLiquidityETH call targets the uniswapV2Router state variable.
transfer delegates all accounting to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates all accounting to _transfer.
airdrop moves tokens through the internal _transfer routine.
airdropArray loops calling airdropInternal which reaches _transfer.
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify, which makes external router/ETH calls before the caller's token accounting completes.
_transfer finalizes accounting by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer reads balanceOf(address(this)) to size the contract token balance.
swapAndLiquify swaps half of the tokens for ETH.
swapAndLiquify adds the remaining tokens and received ETH as liquidity.
swapAndLiquify makes an external ETH transfer to marketingWallet; the lockTheSwap flag guards re-entry.
_tokenTransfer dispatches standard transfers to _transferStandard.
_tokenTransfer dispatches excluded-sender transfers to _transferFromExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches excluded-recipient transfers to _transferToExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches both-excluded transfers to _transferBothExcluded.
_transferStandard computes amounts with _getValues.
_transferFromExcluded computes amounts with _getValues.
_transferToExcluded computes amounts with _getValues.
_transferBothExcluded computes amounts with _getValues.
_transferStandard reflects the fee into _rTotal/_tFeeTotal.
_transferFromExcluded reflects the fee into _rTotal/_tFeeTotal.
_transferToExcluded reflects the fee into _rTotal/_tFeeTotal.
_transferBothExcluded reflects the fee into _rTotal/_tFeeTotal.
_transferStandard routes the liquidity fee via _takeLiquidity.
_transferFromExcluded routes the liquidity fee via _takeLiquidity.
_transferToExcluded routes the liquidity fee via _takeLiquidity.
_transferBothExcluded routes the liquidity fee via _takeLiquidity.
_getValues obtains the current reflection rate from _getRate.
_getValues reaches _getCurrentSupply through the rate computation.
_getRate derives the rate from the supplies returned by _getCurrentSupply.
balanceOf converts reflection balances with tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection uses the current rate from _getRate.
_takeLiquidity converts the token fee using the current rate.
excludeFromReward snapshots the account balance via tokenFromReflection.
deliver reduces _rTotal by the caller's reflection amount.
airdropArray's loop counter iterator bounds the array traversal.
swapAndLiquify consumes the passed contract token balance.
takeFee decides whether fees are removed in _tokenTransfer.
overMinTokenBalance determines whether swapAndLiquify is invoked from _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: from is the sender parameter of _transfer and is normalized into the function.
to is the recipient parameter of _transfer and is normalized into the function.
amount is the transfer amount parameter of _transfer and is normalized into the function.
contractTokenBalance is the parameter of swapAndLiquify and is merged into that function.
SwapThresholdAmount is the configuration parameter of setSwapThresholdAmount.
tokenAddress is the target ERC20 parameter of claimOtherTokens.
walletaddress is the destination parameter of claimOtherTokens.
walletaddress_stuck is the payable destination parameter of clearStuckBalance.
botwallet is the flagged address parameter of addBotWallet.
recipient is the destination parameter of airdrop.
airdropAmount is the amount parameter of airdrop.
tAmount is the token amount parameter of deliver.
time is the lock duration parameter of lock and feeds _lockTime.
_enabled is the toggle parameter of setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled.
tokenAmount_swap is the swap input parameter of swapTokensForEth.
tokenAmount_liq is the token parameter of addLiquidity.
ethAmount is the ETH value parameter of addLiquidity.
contractTokenBalance_local is the contract balance local computed in _transfer.
overMinTokenBalance is the swap-trigger local computed in _transfer.
takeFee is the fee-decision local consumed by _tokenTransfer.
half is the swap split local of swapAndLiquify.
otherHalf is the liquidity split local of swapAndLiquify.
initialBalance is the pre-swap ETH balance local of swapAndLiquify.
newBalance is the swapped ETH amount local of swapAndLiquify.
marketingshare is the ETH share local paid by swapAndLiquify.
iterator is the loop counter local of airdropArray.
currentRate is the cached rate local of _takeLiquidity.
newholders is the recipient array parameter of airdropArray.
amounts is the amount array parameter of airdropArray.
